I design agentic experiences - shaping how systems reason, act, and interact with users across flows, not just screens. Moving beyond interfaces, I focus on behavior, orchestration, and generated outcomes - translating product ideas and AI capabilities into clear, usable systems.

Agentic flows · AI systems · Interaction models · End-to-end design
